name: continuum
description: Privacy-first, event-driven context infrastructure for Codex.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @continuum/contracts && npm run build -w @continuum/core && npm run build -w @continuum/vscode-collector && npm --prefix collectors/chrome run build && npm --prefix packages/cloud run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @continuum/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @continuum/core && npm run build -w @continuum/vscode-collector && npm --prefix packages/cloud run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:collectors && npm run test:native && npm run test:cloud && npm run test:web
scripts.test:collectors: npm run test -w @continuum/vscode-collector && npm --prefix collectors/chrome test && npm --prefix integrations/zsh test && npm --prefix integrations/git test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:mcp
scripts.smoke:apple: npm run build -w @continuum/core && tsx packages/continuum/test/provider-smoke.ts apple
scripts.smoke:ollama: npm run build -w @continuum/core && tsx packages/continuum/test/provider-smoke.ts ollama gemma3n:e2b
scripts.smoke:openai: npm run build -w @continuum/core && tsx packages/continuum/test/provider-smoke.ts openai gpt-5.6-terra
